discription: A plucky, percussive sawtooth wave synth with a short decay envelope and a modulated low-pass filter for a bright, transient sound.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, attack=0.005, decay=0.2, cutoffBase=1000, cutoffMod=3000; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(attack, decay, 0.0, 0.1, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = Saw.ar(freq); sig = LPF.ar(sig, cutoffBase + (env * cutoffMod)); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
